multi_entity_note: Immunotolerance, Inc. (Company) and Alan Crane (Consultant) are distinct parties in different roles.
processing_note: The Consultant shall submit to the Company itemized monthly statements, in a form satisfactory to the Company, of such expenses incurred in the previous month.

contract.document_name.rationale: The agreement names itself Consulting Agreement in the title and preamble.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The preamble says the agreement is made this 27th day of March, 2017.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The term refers to an Effective Date that is never defined or given a date; the preamble date is the making date.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The initial term runs to the four-year anniversary of an undefined Effective Date, which is not stated as a date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 16 selects the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Section 2 provides automatic renewal for successive one-year periods.

contract.notice_period.rationale: The Company must give 90 days' notice before a successive period to prevent renewal.
